insights.headline: Rupee rebounds nearly 1% on RBI measures as oil shock and Fed hawks keep gold pinned below $4,200
insights.summary: The rupee bounced nearly 1% to 95.77 a dollar on Monday after the RBI opened a special window for state oil companies' dollar demand, easing spot pressure. Gold stayed on the defensive: an oil-price shock drove the dollar to 18-month highs, Cleveland Fed's Hammack urged a quick move to restrictive policy, and traders braced for Wednesday's US September CPI. On MCX, gold and silver traded range-bound as the firmer rupee cushioned domestic prices, while record-high bullion pushed Indian shoppers toward diamond jewellery.
points: Rupee rose ~1% to 95.77/USD after RBI curbs on speculative trades; importers buying dollars at lower levels capped gains.
Brent above $100 and US Treasury yields above 5.2% kept the dollar at 18-month highs, pressing spot gold near $4,168.
Cleveland Fed's Hammack called for moving 'relatively quickly' to restrictive policy; about 85% of a December hike is priced.
MCX gold futures held near Rs 1.51 lakh and silver near Rs 2.26 lakh/kg; diamond jewellery sales seen up 15-20% this festive season.
Wednesday's US September CPI (due Oct 14) is the week's deciding catalyst for bullion direction.

trending.title: Oil shock + strong dollar squeeze gold below $4,175
trending.summary: Brent held above $100 amid attacks in Saudi Arabia, driving the dollar to 18-month highs and Treasury yields to 24-year highs; spot gold slipped to $4,167.98 as Fed hike bets revived.

trending.title: Fed hawks turn up the heat before Wednesday CPI
trending.summary: Hammack urged a 'relatively quick' move to restrictive policy; markets price ~85% odds of a December hike, and Wednesday's US September CPI (Oct 14) decides gold's next leg.

trending.title: Rupee bounce cushions the Indian bid
trending.summary: The rupee's ~1% rebound to 95.77 on RBI measures offset global weakness for Indian buyers; MCX gold held near Rs 1.51 lakh and silver near Rs 2.26 lakh, with pre-Dussehra dip a buying window.

trending.title: High gold prices push India toward diamonds
trending.summary: Soaring bullion is shifting festive shoppers to diamond jewellery; retailers expect studded sales to grow up to 20% this season, with Navratri off to a firm start.

trending.title: Silver and central banks stay in the mix
trending.summary: Comex silver settled 0.87% lower at $60.141 while Indian retail silver held Rs 2.40 lakh/kg; Kazakhstan plans to trim gold to 75% of reserves by end-2026, reallocating toward dollar assets.

items.title: Gold tumbles as Oil shock fuels US Dollar rally and Fed hike bets
items.summary: FXStreet: gold tumbled as an oil-price shock drove the US dollar to 18-month highs and revived Fed hike bets. Reuters: Brent rose to $106.52 on attacks on Saudi Arabia while spot gold fell 0.62% to $4,167.98/oz and Treasury yields hit 24-year highs. Cleveland Fed's Hammack urged moving 'relatively quickly' to restrictive policy as inflation runs in the mid-to-high 2% range.

items.title: Rupee rebounds nearly 1% after RBI moves to curb speculative trades
items.summary: Economic Times: the rupee bounced back nearly 100 paise, about 1%, to 95.77 a dollar on Monday from near its all-time low after RBI curbs on speculative currency trades. A separate window for state oil companies' dollar demand eased spot pressure, though importer buying capped gains. Emkay's Madhavi Arora called the measures tactical fixes, with Brent above $100 and yields above 5.2% weighing.

items.title: Gold price surge boosts diamond jewellery sales 15-20%
items.summary: Economic Times: soaring gold prices are pushing Indian jewellery shoppers toward diamonds, and retailers expect diamond jewellery sales to grow up to 20% this festive season. Joyalukkas reports an uptick as diamond pieces fit consumer budgets, Senco Gold expects everyday-wear diamond jewellery to gain traction, and Navratri started on a firm note for studded jewellery.

items.title: Gold fails to sustain a break above $4,200, US CPI in focus
items.summary: FXStreet: gold probed above $4,200 but failed to hold as traders positioned for Wednesday's US September CPI. Supports sit at $4,052 and $4,000; a break of resistance at $4,225 opens $4,398. With ~85% of a December Fed hike priced and the dollar at 18-month highs, CPI is the week's deciding catalyst.

items.title: Kazakhstan central bank to cut gold share of reserves to 75% by year-end
items.summary: PANews: the National Bank of Kazakhstan plans to trim gold from 78% to 75% of its reserves by end-2026, reallocating toward dollar assets. Kazakhstan is among the world's largest official gold holders, so the pivot is a notable central-bank demand signal.

items.title: Gold price outlook: weekly bottom confirmed, two key levels still matter
items.summary: Kitco technical analysis: gold has confirmed a weekly bottom, but daily closes above $4,181.79 and then $4,227.85 are still needed to confirm the uptrend. A sustained break opens $4,602.57; a weekly close below the low would invalidate the setup.

items.title: Comex silver settles 0.87% lower at $60.141
items.summary: Dow Jones Data Talk via Morningstar: Comex silver settled 0.87% lower at $60.141 on Monday, pulling back from recent highs as traders squared positions ahead of US inflation data.

items.title: Gold and silver price forecast: key breakout levels to watch before September CPI
items.summary: FXEmpire: gold targets $4,330 on a break above $4,250, while silver — leading the move — targets $72 above $65. With ~85% of a December Fed hike priced, Wednesday's September CPI (due Oct 14) is the trigger for the next leg.

items.title: Gold, silver prices fall ahead of Dussehra; what festive buyers should know
items.summary: Upstox: MCX gold futures fell 0.41% to Rs 1,51,100 and silver 0.16% to Rs 2,25,770 on Monday as a firmer rupee and profit-booking weighed. 24K gold stood at Rs 1,50,420/10g. Analysts quoted see the pre-Dussehra dip as a window for festive buyers.

items.title: Gold and silver likely to trade range-bound as rupee weakness cushions prices
items.summary: Particle News: MCX December gold holding near Rs 1.51 lakh and Comex December gold around $4,216 are expected to trade range-bound, with rupee softness cushioning domestic prices against global weakness. Key supports and resistances to watch.

items.title: Indian markets pre-market report: bullion steady as USD/INR holds 96.73
items.summary: KarTalks pre-market: spot gold $4,212 (+0.42%), silver $61.25 (+0.70%); MCX gold December Rs 1,51,503 and silver December Rs 2,25,820, with USD/INR at 96.73. Traders eye Wednesday's US CPI for direction.

items.title: Gold prices ease ahead of Dussehra; buyers get relief as rates dip slightly
items.summary: The Orissa Today: gold prices edged lower on Monday, giving Dussehra shoppers slight relief, with 24K gold around Rs 1,50,750/10g in major cities. Festive demand is expected to pick up through the week; silver also softened.

items.title: Silver price today: rates jump 2.17% to Rs 2.40 lakh/kg
items.summary: HDFC Sky: silver rates rose 2.17% to Rs 2.40 lakh/kg on Monday. With Dussehra, Dhanteras and Diwali approaching, jewellers expect more buyers for silver coins, idols and utensils in the coming weeks.
